items.title: Production web build passes
items.evidence: vite.config.ts with chunked vendor splits + health.json plugin; dist/ output verified.

items.title: Environment variables fully documented
items.evidence: docs/web/env-vars.md enumerates VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, VITE_SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID, VITE_PUBLIC_HOST, VITE_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY.

items.title: Auth/session works in production
items.evidence: ProtectedRoute + onAuthStateChange wired in App.tsx; Supabase client persists session in localStorage.

items.title: PWA behavior is correct (manifest + install)
items.evidence: public/manifest.webmanifest with name/short_name/icons/display=standalone; iframe-guarded SW registration.

items.title: Service worker behavior is correct (preview/iframe guarded)
items.evidence: src/main.tsx checks isInIframe + isPreviewHost before navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js'); public/sw.js install uses Promise.allSettled (tolerant).

items.title: Push on web works where supported (VAPID)
items.evidence: public/sw.js handles push + notificationclick + push-track callback; VAPID public key flows through services/push-token-lifecycle.ts.

items.title: File handling works in browser-safe ways (user-mediated picker only)
items.evidence: src/lib/web-platform/web-fallbacks.ts — no silent disk access; File System Access API or <input type=file>.

items.title: No native-only feature is exposed without gating
items.evidence: WEB_RUNTIME_CONTRACT enumerates platformProhibited capabilities; UI guards via webCapability().

items.title: Web routing works with deep links and refreshes
items.evidence: BrowserRouter in App.tsx; nginx try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html SPA fallback in nginx/default.conf.

items.title: SEO/public assets valid (robots, sitemap, OG, canonical)
items.evidence: public/robots.txt + public/sitemap.xml + index.html OG/Twitter/canonical tags present; vite publicHostRewritePlugin auto-rewrites https://app.sita.os → $WEB_PUBLIC_HOST in dist/ on build.

items.title: CSP / security headers defined and consistent across hosts
items.evidence: index.html meta CSP + nginx/default.conf + deploy/nginx.conf all pin https://fctupowhcljejygjfpty.supabase.co + ai.gateway.lovable.dev.

items.title: Error boundaries deployed and tested
items.evidence: GlobalErrorBoundary + RouteErrorBoundary + WindowErrorBoundary wired in App.tsx; initErrorMonitoring() global capture.
